title: The Productivity Claims Seminar · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short report (about 150 words) for a student newsletter. Summarize the seminar's three claims using careful reporting verbs (report, explain, point out, indicate) and appropriate quantifiers (some, most, all). Do not exaggerate the evidence. End with one sentence about what the seminar taught you.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
